public_payload.normalized_proposition: The tech industry's and media's failures will cause a market correction that likely dwarfs the Dot Com Bubble.

statement.excerpt: The failure of both parties to meet the moment with clarity and purpose will lead to a market correction that likely dwarfs the Dot Com Bubble, exposing many of those involved as a phoney, a fraud, an imbecile, a ghoul, a coward, or utterly, impossibly ignorant.

from_speaker: will lead to a market correction
likely dwarfs the Dot Com Bubble
our_interpretation: In context, both parties means the technology industry and the media, not political parties.
The ordinary reading is a future AI-related market downturn substantially more severe than the dot-com bust. It does not mean merely a larger nominal dollar loss in a larger market.

For comparison, use peak-to-trough percentage losses in a consistent US technology-market index, with a broad-market index as a cross-check. These are evaluator-selected measures, not measures named by Zitron.
Dwarfs means substantially exceeds; the speaker gives no numerical margin. A borderline comparison would remain unresolved.
Likely qualifies the predicted severity. A single eventual event can test the forecasted outcome but cannot establish whether its unstated probability was well calibrated.
The causal attribution requires separate evidence connecting identifiable industry and media conduct to the correction.
The insults are rhetorical judgments and are not included in the testable market forecast.
criteria.support_condition: A dated AI-related market correction produces percentage losses substantially greater than the dot-com comparison on consistent measures, with credible evidence that the identified industry and media failures materially contributed.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A completed, clearly identified AI bust has losses materially below the dot-com comparison, or credible causal evidence refutes the asserted mechanism for that episode. Mere passage of time without a correction cannot contradict this undated forecast.

A substantially larger observed decline could settle support early; a smaller ongoing decline could not.
